mainEntity.name: What types of stains and sealants are best for log homes in Colorado?

acceptedAnswer.text: For log homes in Colorado, it's crucial to choose stains and sealants designed to withstand high UV exposure, extreme temperature fluctuations, and moisture. Oil-based or water-based penetrating stains are common, offering good protection and aesthetics. Durable clear topcoats are then applied to further enhance UV resistance and water repellency. We can recommend specific products based on your home's needs and desired look.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Colorado, select stains and sealants that offer strong UV protection and can handle temperature extremes.
